messages:
Priya M.: Quick follow-up from today: can we consolidate the release cadence guidance and oncall changes into a short checklist?
Sam H.: Yep. High level: prefer a 3-week planning cadence to reduce mid-sprint churn. Not mandatory  teams can keep 2 or 4 weeks if it fits.
Jules K.: If teams move to 3 weeks, do oncall rotations shift?
Sam H.: We'll move primary oncall to 7-day rotations (Mon-Sun) to cut handoffs. Secondaries keep current overnight/holiday split.
Aria L.: Any SLA changes to paging?
Sam H.: Paging policy unchanged. Sev1: page immediately; ack SLA 15m; mitigation plan within 30m. We're improving runbook steps to map actions to the 15/30 targets.
Ken P.: For Dedicated customers, what p95 targets are we committing to?
Sam H.: Default Dedicated gen models: p95 <= 250ms. Long-context variants will have model-profile SLAs (example: 64k context p95 <= 700ms). We'll document exceptions per model.
Lina S.: How will we enforce quality bars in rollouts?
Sam H.: New requirement: every model rollout needs an eval harness with baseline prompts and metrics. No-regression gates on embedding similarity + toxicity checks. Canary stage required with automated metric checks.
Priya M.: Can you paste the rollout template we agreed?
Sam H.: Example default template: {"canary_percent":5,"stages":[5,25,100],"health_metrics":["p95_latency","error_rate","quality_regressions"],"auto_promote_on":"all_checks_green"}
Jules K.: Will CI auto-promote?
Sam H.: Yes  auto-promote after 2 consecutive green evals and no new errors for 30m. Ops can abort via the deployment dashboard.
Aria L.: Who will update runbooks and post-release checklists?
Jules K.: I'll own runbooks. Aria will own post-release checklist and eval prompt sets.
Ken P.: I'll update SLA comms and status pages.
Priya M.: Action items: Sam update rollout template in infra repo; Jules refresh runbooks; Aria publish eval sets; Ken draft customer SLA blurb. Drop PR links in #eng-process. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment triggered for release/infra-2026-03 at 2123456900 :rocket:
Lina S.: Any change to postmortem timing?
Sam H.: No  keep 72h initial summary, 7-day RCA. Adding quick health checks at 2h and 24h post-major rollout.
Priya M.: Thanks all  we'll track progress in next leadership check-in.
Jules K.: PR incoming today.
Aria L.: Eval harness by EOD tomorrow.
Ken P.: Draft SLA blurb later today.
